Quick pass on demo script (attached). Major suggestions below — want to keep the live demo to 6–8 minutes to leave room for Q&A.

[Attachment: DemoScript_v3.md]

Suggested flow (abbr):
1) 60s: Problem framing — high-level latency/cost pain for inference at scale
2) 90s: Redwood differentiator — unified runtime + routing + cost controls (use simple diagram)
3) 6–8 min: Live demo — two short prompts (search re-ranking example + customer personalization snippet). Use pre-warmed model, explicit prompt template, and fallback to smaller quantized model for the second prompt.
4) 60s: Customer highlight — show before/after metrics (Acme excerpt)
5) 2–3 min: CTA + how to engage (trial, dedicated, private)

Tech notes for producer / AV: please confirm tokenization-friendly font for slides, and that the demo machine will have outbound access to Redwood demo endpoints (we will provide credentials).

Jordan — can you confirm which model variant you want pre-warmed and whether we should stage a cached prefix to reduce cold-start risk?

Thanks,
Karthik
